levels.surface: أبو عبد الله الحسين بن محمد

notes: «عن أبيه محمد بن علي»: the bare «أبيه» with his name is one link, the name alone (rule 7); the Imam inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator
the gloss «ابن أخت خالد بن مخلد القطواني» is left out; the saying after «ثم قال» is the father's own words

fixes.reason: THQ's English ends the chain at Ja'far b. Muhammad; the text runs one link further to his father Muhammad b. Ali

evidence.quote: عن جعفر بن محمد عن أبيه محمد بن علي
from Imam Ja’far bin Muhammad as-Sadiq (as)
